rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something pleasant or satisfactory, a generally good or decent person, or a favorable assessment.

example.english: The food at this restaurant is nice.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2

rows.note: Use this construction before another adjective when the result is pleasantly or desirably A, as in 好熱 for “nice and hot.”

example.english: The soup is nice and hot today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 tong1 hou2 jit6

rows.note: Choose this when “nice” specifically describes someone as friendly and well-disposed toward others.

example.english: The new neighbour is very nice to people.
example.jyutping: san1 leon4 geoi1 deoi3 jan4 hou2 jau5 sin6

rows.note: Use this for something properly expressed, refined, or socially seemly, especially a way of putting something.

example.english: The way you put it is really nice.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 zan1 hai6 dak1 tai2
